{{Quote|Eclectic adornments are what I'm all about.|Clem Stato|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''</ref>}}
'''Clem Stato''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A merchant like his relatives [[Meridat Stato|Meridat]], [[Felusia Stato|Felusia]], and [[Nelva Stato|Nelva]], Clem Stato sold furniture and decorations on the [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] [[Carrick Station]] and [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Cartel Market Decorations vendor who appears on both the Republic and Imperial Fleets, Clem Stato was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the [[2014]] Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds|''Galactic Strongholds'']].<ref name="TOR" />
